title: CHIM Boundary and Self-Reference Controls
summary: Limits forced awakening, recursive identity pressure, destabilizing self-reference, and claims that insight places an operator above ordinary constraints.
mechanism: The control paces disclosure, blocks coercive recursion, and keeps insight compatible with correction, ordinary responsibility, and exit.
test_status: Safety boundary is specified; expert human-factors validation is open.
next_tests: Measure false positives and user comprehension
